warnings: No dimensions are given in the text and no drawing is visible, so the size is estimated. Assumptions: the board is roughly 48 x 48 mm, about 6 buttons-widths across, with 6 mm tactile switches and 2.54 mm pin-header pitch as scale references. Estimated Z of 14 mm covers the PCB, the backing layer, the tall tactile buttons (about 5 mm) and the header pins standing up above the board. The board shows small mounting holes at the corners, about 2-3 mm in diameter, but their exact positions and diameters cannot be measured, so none are listed. The battery tray (roughly 4-cell AA size) and the 3-wire cable are not included in the bounds. The backing layer thickness is a guess.
Dimensions are visual estimates; the source gives none.
Height is placed on Y (14 mm) per the Y=0 bottom rule, while the analysis lists Z as height; X and Z are both 48 mm.
Corner mounting holes were omitted because their positions and diameters are uncertain.
The L-shaped notch in the backing pad, the crystal/SMD parts and the battery tray and cable were omitted.
Header pins are modeled as vertical, which is assumed from the 14 mm height estimate; in the image they may be right-angle.
Button and header positions are approximate.
